label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: Every country team keeps emailing that their invoices are urgent, but there is no set priority order. I end up wasting time asking around and missing my daily SAP quota by about 20 invoices. For example, last Tuesday both Vietnam and Thailand asked for same-day payment; I picked Vietnam first and my lead was unhappy. It would really help if we had a simple priority order from our lead, or just one designated person who decides.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports that multiple teams request urgent invoice processing without a defined priority order, leading to missed daily quotas and unclear expectations from leadership. [ROLE_CLARITY, MANAGER_SUPPORT] "Every country team keeps emailing that their invoices are urgent, but there is no set priority order."
